name: comp-287
title: Changes Saved Notification
blurb: Success notification with message, undo button, and dismiss.
description: Static success notification showing change confirmation with green checkmark, message line, action button, and dismissible close. No hooks.
use_when: You need to confirm a user action was saved with an immediate way to undo or dismiss.
avoid_when: For stacked notifications or auto-disappearing toasts; use a dedicated toast system instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icons marked aria-hidden. No motion or animation.
